in_sanskrit.name: Bhanumati
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhana (दिन, सूर्य) + Uma (देवी) + Mati (विज्ञान, ध्यान, प्रसाद) => Goddess of the Sun (Bhana is 'Sun', Uma is 'Goddess' and Mati is 'Intellect', 'Wisdom' or 'Grace')

in_hindi.name: भानुमती
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bhānu (सूर्य) + Matī (माता) => Goddess of the Sun

in_tamil.name: பானுமதி
in_tamil.long_meaning: Bānu (சொல்லிவான், ஸூர்ய) + Mati (மாதிரி, அம்மா) => Goddess of the Sun

in_telugu.name: భానుమతి
in_telugu.long_meaning: Bhānu (ఆదిపోయిపోయిన, సூర్य) + Mati (ఆమ్మె) => Goddess of the Sun

in_marathi.name: Bhanumati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wisdom and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhanumati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhanumati is a divine feminine name derived from Sanskrit. It is composed of two words: Bhana (meaning 'to shine') and Mati (meaning 'wisdom'). This name signifies the goddess who bestows both wisdom and prosperity upon her devotees.
